title: Phase 1.5 OOD diagnosis — aggregate-derived results
method: Exact summaries of previously scored per-type multiset TP/FP/FN; metric formatting reused from the updated analyzer. Prediction archives and report checksums verified. Not a fresh analyzer run.
warnings: All three normalized ground-truth datasets are absent. The updated offline analyzer could not be rerun.
Ground-truth offsets, adapter categories before DATE/TIME normalization, and source annotations could not be independently revalidated.
FN/FP failure categories are entity counts. Confusions and structural patterns count overlap pairs; boundary flags are nonexclusive.
Scored FPs mean unmatched benchmark annotations, not independently adjudicated real-world detector errors.
